.github/workflows/ci.yml.text:
name: CI
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: alageum_ci
          POSTGRES_USER: alageum
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci-password
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U alageum -d alageum_ci"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 10
    env:
      APP_DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://alageum:ci-password@localhost:5432/alageum_ci
      APP_SECRET_KEY: ci-secret-key-that-is-long-enough
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: backend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r requirements-dev.lock
      - run: pip-audit -r requirements.lock
      - run: ruff check .
      - run: python ../scripts/test_backend_readiness.py
      - run: python ../scripts/check_vercel_runtime_lock.py
      - name: Verify the explicit legacy route inventory
        run: python ../scripts/check_legacy_route_inventory.py
      - name: Reproduce frozen FastAPI query reference vectors
        run: python ../backend-node/tests/reference/generate_legacy_query.py --check
      - name: Reproduce frozen system DTO and metric reference vectors
        run: python ../backend-node/tests/reference/generate_legacy_system.py --check
      - name: Reproduce frozen quote-create limiter reference vectors
        run: python ../backend-node/tests/reference/generate_legacy_quote_limit.py --check
      - run: pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing
      - run: alembic upgrade head
      - run: alembic downgrade base
      - run: alembic upgrade head
      - run: alembic check
      - name: Verify RFQ transactions on PostgreSQL (including concurrent retries)
        run: pytest tests/test_quote_requests.py
        env:
          ALAGEUM_TEST_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://alageum:ci-password@localhost:5432/alageum_ci
  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - run: npm install --global npm@11.6.2
      - run: npm ci
      - run: python3 scripts/update_catalog_assets.py --check
        working-directory: .
      - run: python3 scripts/check_frontend_env.py
        working-directory: .
      - run: npm audit --audit-level=high
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run test:unit
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm run build:preview

  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [backend, frontend]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - run: npm install --global npm@11.6.2
      - run: cp .env.example .env
      - run: ./scripts/bootstrap.sh
      - run: docker compose run --rm -v "$PWD/docs/catalog-import:/catalog:ro" backend python -m scripts.import_catalog --catalog-dir /catalog
      - run: |
          backup_path="$(./scripts/backup.sh)"
          ./scripts/restore.sh "${backup_path}"
          python3 scripts/smoke.py
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: frontend
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
        working-directory: frontend
      - run: npm run test:e2e
        working-directory: frontend
      - if: always()
        run: docker compose logs --no-color > compose-e2e.log
      - if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-failure-context-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            frontend/test-results/
            frontend/playwright-report/
            compose-e2e.log
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain public company-page retry diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: company-page-retry-context-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            frontend/test-results/company-pages-*/test-failed-*.png
            frontend/test-results/company-pages-*/error-context.md
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
      - if: always()
        run: docker compose down -v

  vercel-services:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [backend, frontend]
    permissions:
      contents: read
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: alageum_vercel_ci
          POSTGRES_USER: alageum
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci-password
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U alageum -d alageum_vercel_ci"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 10
    env:
      APP_ENV: test
      APP_DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://alageum:ci-password@localhost:5432/alageum_vercel_ci
      APP_SECRET_KEY: ci-only-vercel-services-secret-not-for-deployment
      APP_LOCAL_STORAGE_PATH: /tmp/alageum-vercel-ci-storage
      APP_CORS_ORIGINS: '["http://localhost:3200"]'
      NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: /api/v1
      NEXT_PUBLIC_CATALOG_SOURCE: static
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
      VERCEL_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
      E2E_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3200
      E2E_API_URL: http://localhost:3200/api/v1
      E2E_VERCEL_SERVICES: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: npm install --global npm@11.6.2
      - run: npm install --global vercel@62.1.0
      - run: pip install uv==0.12.19
      - name: Install locked backend and prepare disposable database
        working-directory: backend
        run: |
          uv sync --locked --no-dev
          .venv/bin/alembic upgrade head
          .venv/bin/python -m scripts.seed
          .venv/bin/python -m scripts.import_catalog --catalog-dir ../docs/catalog-import
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: frontend
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
        working-directory: frontend
      - name: Verify actual Vercel Services ingress and browser flows locally
        timeout-minutes: 12
        shell: bash
        run: |
          setsid vercel dev -L --listen 127.0.0.1:3200 > vercel-services.log 2>&1 &
          server_pid=$!
          cleanup() {
            kill -- -"${server_pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
            wait "${server_pid}" || true
          }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          deadline=$((SECONDS + 180))
          until curl --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 \
            "${E2E_API_URL}/readiness" > /dev/null; do
            if ! kill -0 "${server_pid}" 2>/dev/null || (( SECONDS >= deadline )); then
              tail -100 vercel-services.log
              echo "Vercel Services did not become ready" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          cd frontend
          # Fail quickly on a shared ingress/hydration problem before the full suite.
          npm run test:e2e:vercel -- e2e/vercel-services.spec.js --max-failures=1
          npm run test:e2e:vercel -- e2e/catalog-admin.spec.js e2e/catalog.spec.js e2e/security.spec.js --max-failures=1
      - if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: vercel-services-failure-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            vercel-services.log
            frontend/test-results/
            frontend/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7

  transformer-source-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      NEXT_PUBLIC_CATALOG_SOURCE: static
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
      E2E_CATALOG_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:3100
      PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE: playwright-report/catalog-results.json
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Build the production static catalog
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: npm run build
      - name: Verify new source assets and old catalog regressions on desktop and mobile
        timeout-minutes: 18
        shell: bash
        run: |
          npm run start -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3100 > catalog-browser.log 2>&1 &
          web_pid=$!
          cleanup() {
            kill "${web_pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
            wait "${web_pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
          }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          deadline=$((SECONDS + 90))
          until curl --fail --silent --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 "${E2E_CATALOG_BASE_URL}/catalog" > /dev/null; do
            if ! kill -0 "${web_pid}" || (( SECONDS >= deadline )); then
              tail -80 catalog-browser.log
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          npm run test:e2e:catalog -- --reporter=github,json
      - if: always()
        id: catalog_full_artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: transformer-source-browser-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            frontend/test-results/
            frontend/playwright-report/
            frontend/catalog-browser.log
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Prepare bounded catalog diagnostics from existing evidence
        id: catalog_diagnostics
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          CATALOG_FULL_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ steps.catalog_full_artifact.outputs.artifact-id }}
          CATALOG_FULL_ARTIFACT_URL: ${{ steps.catalog_full_artifact.outputs.artifact-url }}
          CATALOG_FULL_ARTIFACT_DIGEST: ${{ steps.catalog_full_artifact.outputs.artifact-digest }}
          CATALOG_FULL_UPLOAD_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome }}
        run: node scripts/prepare-catalog-diagnostics.mjs "${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics"
      - name: Retain compact catalog report diagnostics
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalog-diagnostics-report-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics/report/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain compact catalog desktop diagnostics
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalog-diagnostics-desktop-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics/desktop/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain compact catalog mobile diagnostics
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalog-diagnostics-mobile-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics/mobile/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain compact catalog shared diagnostics
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalog-diagnostics-shared-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics/shared/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain compact catalog mobile part 001
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success' && steps.catalog_diagnostics.outputs.mobile_part_count >= 1
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalog-diagnostics-mobile-part-001-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics/mobile-part-001/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain compact catalog mobile part 002
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success' && steps.catalog_diagnostics.outputs.mobile_part_count >= 2
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalog-diagnostics-mobile-part-002-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics/mobile-part-002/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain compact catalog mobile part 003
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success' && steps.catalog_diagnostics.outputs.mobile_part_count >= 3
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalog-diagnostics-mobile-part-003-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics/mobile-part-003/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Retain compact catalog mobile part 004
        if: always() && steps.catalog_full_artifact.outcome == 'success' && steps.catalog_diagnostics.outputs.mobile_part_count >= 4
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: catalog-diagnostics-mobile-part-004-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/catalog-diagnostics/mobile-part-004/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
